Results.ReviewText: Am truly enjoying this Spirit II E-310 gas grill and very happy with this purchase. Burners light quickly & with no effort.  Unit heats up quite quickly and is ready to go within 5-10 minutes.  Have had great success with controlling heat during grilling process, and have begun to experiment with items that were much trickier to grill on my old Weber charcoal kettle.  I went with this 3-burner grill as opposed to a 2-burner unit because I wanted to be able to do indirect grilling.  I was able to cook a small pork roast using indirect heat (used only burners on each side) that turned out great -- still juicy and wonderfully tender.
Results.Title: Quick & Easy Grilling

Results.ReviewText: The Spirit II E-310 heats up rapidly. Faster than most grills I’ve had in the past. It’s the equivalent of going from 0-60 in two seconds. It’s a compact three-burner that packs a punch and can easily handle 8 ribeyes at a time. The thermometer is reliable and accurate. The grates easy to clean. Though I use it on a rather large patio, this little baby is the perfect fit for apartment dwellers. One other note: while having our kitchen remodeled the Spirit II was our go-to alternative to a stove for over two months. It held up to lots of use on a regular basis. Reasonably priced and with a 10-Year Weber bumper-to-bumper warranty, you can’t beat it.
Results.Title: Spirit II is the Grill for You

Results.ReviewText:
Grill was assembled for free by Home Depot and they did a good job
Grill heats up quickly (approx. 7 minutes to get to 500 degrees, in mid 80 degree weather) and can get up to 575 degrees when all burners on high, which is good for burning off anything left on the grate.   Still getting used to what burner knob positions correspond to a given temperature.   Cleaning grate works well using a stiff grill nylon brush after burn off and cool down.   Like the shape of the firebox (angled flat surfaces with no raised ridges) as it will make cleaner easier than my old grill .  Porcelain hood is easy to clean and looks nice.   Gas weight gauge is a little finicky as the LP tank side is held away from the grill by two rubber bumps that touch the lower side of the LP tank which can cause friction and effect the gauge to some extent, so sometimes I have to lightly pull outward on the bottom of the tank  to get a reasonable reading.  May try some lubricant on the rubber bumps to see if that helps.  Nice to have a 10 year warranty on the grill.  Overall pleased with the grill so far.
Results.Title: Nice grill

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
